body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress the numerical penalties of one non-Critical physical Wound Condition until the start of your next turn. Reduce your next incoming Damage by 1 during that time.

surges.html: Extend only the suppression through the end of your next turn.
Gain +1 Fortitude until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Combo - Guard
rider.html: You may spend 1 Combo to enter Broken Reed Stance: each time you would lose Combo from a Core Wound, lose at most 1 from that entire Damage event. Injuries still apply.
